source_basis.scope: One actual policy caller and source-review/roadmap evidence only. Scientific APIs, runtime manifests, native artifacts, other SDK pins and shared prefixes unchanged.

policy.admission: Already registered in the exact frozen policy; no admission_sha needed.
policy.live_frozen_difference: One additional BindingMT/TopoMT source-evidence edge on live main. Same latest-policy target, this member constraints, guide and resource rule.
policy.synchronization: Official registered delivery already present; read-only official synchronizer confirms the selected guide copy. No manual guide edit or waived preflight.
semantic_review: Root/common precedence and task-relevant nested devguide/tests instruction routes remain mandatory.
TypeScript/MolSysSketcher additions have no new scientific runtime dependency or admission requirement for the registered MolSysMT Python/Rust member.
ArgDigest, DepDigest, SMonitor, PyUnitWizard, Ackredit and receptors keep their existing validated/lazy/units/attribution/reporting roles; this workflow update adopts no newer runtime versions.
Scientific and installed SDK/verification/action pins remain unchanged; no source/runtime functionality is added.

quality.native_thread_caps: Final family explicitly sets OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL/BLIS/NumExpr/Rayon/OpenMM/build-worker caps to one; no compilation or solver executed.
quality.scope: Existing local fast gates/Ruff only. Not heavy scientific/full-source/platform/installed or hosted qualification.
quality.final_declarative_refresh: Receipt/roadmap-only final edits are validated again with the devguide/index/whitespace checks before commit.

resource_review.active_operator_policy: Principal maintainer shared-host session policy; loaded and applied for this selected task. Numeric selected budgets remain task observations, not new AGENTS/site rules.
resource_review.route: Session-authorized direct systemd user process families. No Slurm command/allocation observed; no inference that Slurm is globally absent.
resource_review.visibility: Current RAM/pressure/swap inspected. The task process namespace exposes only limited processes, so it does not inventory all foreign host work.
resource_review.input: About 12.7 MB/714 tracked files of exact official source, current member declarations/guide and small GitHub metadata. No trajectory, browser/kernel, accelerator workload, solver or compiler.
resource_review.estimate: Existing same-host administrative fast selection measured about 384 MiB/30 s; estimate under 1 GiB and 240 s for selected checks before running. Static before/after conformance is measured separately.
resource_review.selected_budget: One owned family at a time, one CPU, two GiB maximum/1800 MiB high, zero owned swap, 256 tasks, finite wall; monitored 6.5 GiB host reserve and pressure stop.
resource_review.protection: Actual whole-family cgroup ceilings and monitoring, independently read by the launcher. Availability is not a reservation; no cooperative reservation or concurrent aggregate admission is claimed.
resource_review.stop_and_cleanup: Reduce/defer or stop only owned work on selected budget/pressure/wall conditions. Preserve outcomes and confirm MainPID zero before another family. No global recovery/foreign process/scratch operation.
resource_review.larger_workloads: Full source/scientific/browser/native-build/solver profiles require their own input/fan-out estimate and existing authorization. This administrative measurement does not qualify them.
resource_review.infrastructure_boundary: Host/scheduler/admission provisioning, enforcement and aggregate protection remain infrastructure-owned. No runtime adapter, host reconfiguration or infrastructure dependency added.

workspace.disposition: Preserve every foreign dirty/ahead/behind/missing state and canonical MolSysSuite worktree. The source-only owned clone uses committed shared objects and does not copy or edit canonical working files.

preserved_preparation_failure.assumption: Frozen registry bytes equal live main registry bytes.
preserved_preparation_failure.correction: Only the unrelated new BindingMT/TopoMT edge differs. Latest target, member constraints, guide and resource rule match. Frozen and live identities remain separate; no validator restriction was changed.

published_receiving: Fresh public caller/guide hashes, remote exact-head and official adoption verification belong to the owning issue closeout. Not claimed by this local dirty-worktree receiving.
hosted: Intentionally skipped under maintainer CI cadence; not a pass. No workflow dispatched.
remaining_gates: Exact coordinated producer/native/scientific/full-source/docs/installed/platform/public-archive gates and construction/publication pause remain. No gate waived.
